retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic portrait of a male subject framed by a white truck window, featuring a desaturated color palette and a mix of bold vintage script and clean sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man leaning out of a white truck window, styled in a corduroy jacket and bandana. The image is characterized by a desaturated, slightly grainy film texture, with a white border at the top and bottom containing contrasting typographic styles.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject framed by the geometric lines of the truck window
Contrast between the heavy black script and the clean white negative space
Textural harmony between the corduroy fabric and the film grain
Horizontal division of the frame into three distinct bands
coreInvariants: White truck as the primary framing device

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, occupying the middle third of the vertical frame, appearing at a medium scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the dark script logo in the top right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move up to the large script logo, then across to the smaller sans-serif title on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space in the top and bottom margins creates a clean, editorial feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and muted beige (truck and jacket)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value in the background; mid-tones are compressed for a cinematic look.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones and grayscale

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight retro script and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Script features thick, rounded strokes with tight kerning
Sans-serif features wide tracking and uniform stroke weight
Rough, distressed edges on the script to match the film grain
characterSpecificRedesigns: Interlocking descenders and ascenders in the script logo
Underline element beneath the sans-serif title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High contrast pairing of a heavy, organic script with a light, mechanical sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider line with a hand-drawn, charcoal-like texture

preserve: The wide tracking of the sans-serif

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, rounded retro feel of the script logo
Provides the clean, modern geometric contrast for the secondary title

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic, desaturated portrait of a man in a corduroy jacket leaning out of a white truck window. Apply heavy film grain and a white border at the top and bottom. Ensure the lighting is soft and natural.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, heavy retro script logo in the top right margin. Add a small, wide-tracked all-caps sans-serif title in the top left margin, underlined with a textured black stroke.

verificationChecks: Is the film grain visible and consistent?
Is the script logo significantly heavier than the sans-serif text?
Is the subject framed clearly by the truck window?
Are the colors desaturated and earthy?

mustRedesign: Avoid using standard modern fonts without distressing
Ensure the truck is white to maintain the negative space balance
postGenerationChecks: Check for proper horizontal alignment of text in margins
Verify the textured line under the left title is present
Ensure the subject's expression is contemplative, not smiling
Confirm the corduroy texture is sharp enough to contrast with the grain
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in [Vehicle/Window Frame] + [Desaturated Earth Tones] + [Heavy Film Grain] + [Top Margin Typography: Heavy Script Right / Wide Sans-Serif Left]
